_comment: Registry of external Indian Sign Language datasets. 'files' lists exactly what the downloader fetches (URL, size, checksum as published by the host). Status fields are updated by tools/download_datasets.py and the import pipeline; never edit them by hand to claim a dataset was processed.

amrita_slr.name: Amrita SLR - Real Time ISL Dataset
amrita_slr.usage_conditions: Attribution required. Use for this educational/research project with citation.
amrita_slr.citation: Sasidharan, R., Rashmi, M., Nair, K. S., Heera Krishna N S, Muraleedharan, K., Bellamkonda, N. G., Rao, S. M., Avvari, S., Prakash, P. B., Rao, D. T. (2025). Amrita SLR - Real Time ISL Dataset (Version 1). Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/dtg9s785v8.1
amrita_slr.description: 50 commonly used ISL signs, ~16 videos per class, 7 signers, 1920x1080 @ 28 fps, indoor/outdoor, standing/sitting.

isl_csltr.name: ISL-CSLTR: Indian Sign Language Dataset for Continuous Sign Language Translation and Recognition
isl_csltr.citation: Elakkiya, R., Natarajan, B. (2021). ISL-CSLTR: Indian Sign Language Dataset for Continuous Sign Language Translation and Recognition (Version 1). Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/kcmpdxky7p.1
isl_csltr.description: 700 sentence-level videos of 100 English sentences by several signers, sentence-level frames and word-level images, CSV mapping videos to sentences.

include.name: INCLUDE: A Large Scale Dataset for Indian Sign Language Recognition
include.usage_conditions: Attribution required. The dataset card asks users to respect the privacy and dignity of the signers.
include.citation: Sridhar, A., Ganesan, R. G., Kumar, P., Khapra, M. (2020). INCLUDE: A Large Scale Dataset for Indian Sign Language Recognition. Proceedings of the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '20), 1366-1375. https://doi.org/10.1145/3394171.3413528
include.description: 4,287 videos of 263 isolated ISL words (56.75 GB). Only the categories listed in 'files' are downloaded (subset chosen for overlap with the app vocabulary). Official train/val/test splits from the HuggingFace metadata are used.
